Interface TaskQueryManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
TaskQueryManagerImpl
public interface TaskQueryManager
Public API for task read operations. Backs GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks, GET /tasks/{taskId}, GET /tasks/search?q=, GET /tasks?status=invalid input: '&assignee'=invalid input: '&dueBefore'=invalid input: '&sort'=.
